_comments.devDependencies.jsdom: Root has no tests of its own — this exists only so npm hoists jsdom to the same node_modules level as the shared vitest package. Without it, vitest's internal bare import('jsdom') can't resolve (extension's jsdom devDependency stays nested instead of hoisting), silently dropping the 2 jsdom-environment test files from extension's suite. Do not remove as 'unused'. See commit 95951c5.
_comments.optionalDependencies: Workaround for npm's optional-deps lockfile bug (npm/cli#4828): a package-lock generated on Windows records ONLY win32 native binaries, so `npm ci` on the Linux CI runner can't load rollup/esbuild and every vitest/vite step fails (CI was red from 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-14 because of this). Listing the Linux x64 binaries as direct optional deps forces them into the lockfile on every platform; npm skips installing them locally on Windows. Versions must track rollup's and vite's bundled esbuild (0.21.x for vite 5) — `npm ls rollup esbuild` when bumping.
